title: Axion Racer
description:
Thrill-seekers and speed demons, wait no longer and dive into the universe of AXION RACER! Take part in ultra-fast futuristic races against a grid of fierce opponents across a dozen varied environments, including deserts, lush forests, and neon cities where loopings, barrel rolls, and high-flying jumps await. Powered by an advanced physics engine, boost, drift, and slam into your rivals to emerge victorious. Unapologetically arcade, you will be thrown into insane races reaching speeds of up to 2,000 km/h! Are you ready?

BECOME A TRUE AXION RACER• Master your Boost – The key to winning on the track: Boost, Cool down, Win 🏆!

• Master 3 difficulty levels – Prove your skills across 3 speed classes.

• 12 original tracks – Race through a variety of unique environments.

• 3 championships – Conquer them all and become the ultimate AXION RACER.

• 12 unique ship models – Each with its own distinct handling style.

VARIOUS GAME MODES• Championships – Claim top spot at the end of 4 intense races.

• Single Race – Hone your piloting skills to dominate the championships.

• Time Trial – Go head-to-head with the clock and set a new personal record.

• An intuitive and fast arcade-style menu.

• Custom synthwave soundtracks designed for every track.
description_short: Thrill-seekers and speed demons, wait no longer and dive into the universe of AXION RACER! Take part in ultra-fast futuristic races against a grid of fierce opponents across a dozen varied environments.
